get_depth_model_list: get a list of available depth model type strings for the consistent depth model registry
get_depth_model_class: get the depth model class for a given type string like mc midas2 or monodepth2
create_depth_model: create an instantiated depth model from a type string like mc midas2 or monodepth2
review_depth_model_registry: review the depth model registry factory functions for supported model types and instantiation
summarize_depth_model_registry: summarize the depth model registry module that provides factory functions for monocular depth estimation models
